notifications.introduction_tips: Notifications continuously monitor your router's connectivity, clients, battery, system performance, and security status. When a selected event occurs, an alert is sent to your designated email address so you can identify issues and important status changes without keeping the Admin Panel open. A GL.iNet Account must be linked before you can use this feature.
notifications.cellular_data_usage_tips: Notifications are sent when data usage reaches the configured limit. You can configure the limit in Cellular settings.
notifications.battery_level_tips: Notifications are sent when the remaining battery level reaches {thresholds}.
notifications.cpu_temperature_tips: Notifications are sent when the CPU temperature reaches {threshold}°C for five consecutive samples, taken once per minute.
notifications.disable_tips: Disabling notifications will stop email alerts for all monitored events. Your event selections will be retained.
notifications.battery_unsupported_msg: This device does not support battery notifications.
notifications.cloud_required_msg: Please enable the cloud service first.
notifications.save_failed_msg: Failed to create or save notification configuration.
notifications.delete_history_tips: This will permanently delete all notification history records. This action cannot be undone.
